title: Un jardin de plantes à parfum sur le toit de Paris Expo Porte de Versailles
summary: Viparis, gérant des principaux sites événementiels de la région parisienne, a inauguré en septembre, au parc des expositions Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, le premier jardin botanique de plantes à parfum sur un toit. author: vincent

title: dsm-firmenich opens new Fine Fragrance flagship in Chelsea, New York
summary: The fragrance maker has opened what it calls its “flagship for Fine Fragrance” at 641 Avenue of the Americas in Chelsea, New York City. The new 44,000-square-foot space brings together perfumers, fragrance development teams, application, digital, and compounding capabilities under one roof. Home to around 100 employees, including nine Fine Fragrance perfumers, the new Chelsea location is designed to foster deeper collaboration, inspire creativity, and accelerate innovation alongside clients... - Industry buzz / North America

title: Silgan Dispensing lends its expertise to Guerlain's Longevity Concentrate
summary: Silgan Dispensing contributed to the design and development of the 30 ml refillable pump bottle created for Guerlain's new Longevity Concentrate in the Orchidée Impériale range. The foremost requirement was compatibility with a complex formula containing many active ingredients, partly derived from the Vanda coerulea orchid, and encapsulated in billions of liposomes.
